package entry
import (
 "fmt"
 "io"
 "os"
 "{{MODULE}}/internal/base/telemetry"
 "go.opentelemetry.io/otel/trace"
)
func Run(out io.Writer, lookup func(string) (string,bool), span trace.Span, err error) error {
 _, _ = lookup("SETTING")
 telemetry.RecordError(span, err)
 _, writeErr := fmt.Fprintln(out, "result")
 return writeErr
}
func Inspect() int { return os.Getpid() }
type Local struct{}
func (Local) RecordError(error) {}
func SameName(local Local, err error) { local.RecordError(err) }
